messages:
Alex W.: Morning all — leaving this thread for async check-ins.

Alex W.: Yesterday: finished migration test for batching, ran load tests against dedicated pool (90th p50 ~ 120ms). Cleaned up a stale kv-cache bug in infer-runtime.

Alex W.: Blockers: need a small update to kernel selector to prefer fp16 for the 7B quantized path — tests flake on long sequences. @Priya K. can you PTAL at the failing CI job? Failing test: `test_kv_sequence_overflow` in eng-runtime.

Alex W.: Today: create a hotfix branch for selector, roll a canary to staging if CI passes. Also will queue the canary rollout for tomorrow morning.

Priya K.: On it — I'll look at the CI logs now. If it's the selector heuristic I'll repro locally. ETA 2h. Ping me if you need me to pair.

Daniel H.: Quick note: I'm blocked on the canary config because autoscaler policy doesn't accept new label `cache_enabled`. @Jamie L. is there an approved rollout policy name or should I add one?

Jamie L.: Use `canary-v2` label for now, we standardized that for recent rollouts. Ops will swap to stable label after validation. :+1:

Maya S.: FYI, customer X reported slight regressions on latency with quantized 7B in eu-west. Might be related to same path. Tagging @Alex W. and @Daniel H.

Alex W.: Thanks @Maya S. — will include customer traces in the issue. If anyone has recent eval prompts that reproduce, drop them here.

Priya K.: CI root cause: kernel selector falling back to conservative path when seq_len > 1024 because of an off-by-one in index check. Small patch ready, pushing in 20m.

OpsBot: Deploybot: Canary rollout for `redwood/runtime:canary-1798` started to staging at https://deploys.internal/1798 :rocket:

Daniel H.: After Priya's patch lands, I'll re-run the canary config and attempt the autoscaler label update. If tests pass I'll schedule canary -> prod tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Alex W.: If anyone wants pairing on the KV issue I'll be online 15:00-17:00 UTC. Otherwise feel free to DM.

Priya K.: Pushed patch and green CI. PTAL @Alex W. and @Daniel H.

Alex W.: Reviewing now. Thanks!

Jamie L.: Nice work team :tada:
